scripts.dev:web: mkdir -p logs && : > logs/web.log && PORT=$(sh -c 'p=3000; while lsof -iTCP:$p -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1; do p=$((p+1)); done; echo $p') && npm run dev --workspace=apps/web -- --port $PORT 2>&1 | tee logs/web.log
scripts.scrape:cloud: gh workflow run scrape.yml && echo 'Scraper triggered! Check progress: gh run list --workflow=scrape.yml -L 1'
scripts.clean: rm -rf apps/web/.next packages/scrapers/dist logs/*.log && echo '✓ cleared .next, scraper dist, logs'
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules && echo '✓ also removed node_modules. run npm install next.'
